# Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (Nagarjuna Kamireddy / Nagarjuna K)

> Lead AI Architect, AI Solutions Architect, Generative AI & Agentic AI Lead, and Corporate AI Trainer with 22 years in enterprise data platforms, SAP BW/BPC/HANA consulting, and production Machine Learning & Agentic AI across India, Malaysia, Singapore, the UK, the US, and Dubai, UAE. Currently based in Dubai, UAE and available immediately on employer visa sponsorship across the UAE/GCC, global relocation, and remote leadership engagements.

Nagarjuna Reddy Kamireddy (also published on CVs, GitHub repositories, and enterprise materials as **Nagarjuna Kamireddy**, **Nagarjuna K**, and **Nagarjun Reddy Kamireddi**) most recently served as AI Architect & Technical Lead at **John Deere** (01/2023 – 10/2026), where he owned architecture, a self-service AWS Terraform deployment platform, and delivery for a **12+ member team across 23+ AI initiatives** — generating **750K+ automated requests and 42K+ hours saved in FY26**. He holds **AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)** and **NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI (NCP-AAI)**, founded **Surya HANA Academy** (~1,000 professionals trained) and runs an **agentic AI engineering programme** for working IT professionals, and maintains **57 public open-source AI repositories** (`github.com/nagarjunak-pixel`, 2,249+ annual contributions).

- [`enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails): Enterprise Help-Desk Hybrid RAG & Guardrails System with C++20 Okapi BM25+Cosine+RRF (76.63x speedup: 0.270 ms vs 20.660 ms Python), Code-Enforced Low-Confidence Refusal, PII/Injection Filters & 25-Case Automated Acceptance Suite (`v1.0.0`, Apache-2.0, 25/25 100% pass, 0% OOS hallucination, 98.10% branch coverage)
- [`enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server): SAP S/4HANA & Enterprise ERP Clean-Core OData v4 MCP Server with EDM Schema Validation, C++20 $filter/BUKRS Row-RBAC Guardrails (67.03x speedup: 0.101 ms vs 6.783 ms Python), PII Masking & SHA-256/SplitMix64 Audit Log (`v1.0.0`, Apache-2.0, 98.05% branch coverage, CLI + FastAPI :8270 + MCP + React UI)
- [`verispec-sdd`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/verispec-sdd): Executable SPEC.md State-Machine Compiler, C++20 CSR Reachability/Deadlock/Livelock Prover (41.58x speedup: 0.063 ms vs 2.608 ms Python) & Hypothesis/TypeScript Property-Test Synthesizer (`v1.0.0`, 98.01% branch coverage, CLI + FastAPI :8200 + MCP + React UI)
- [`weavegraph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph): Semantic Code-Graph Worktree Scheduler, Min-Cut Multi-Agent Task Partitioner & 3-Way AST Semantic Merge Verifier (C++20 + Python + MCP + React)
- [`vecta`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta): Vector Search Engine: HNSW (heuristic neighbour selection, filtered & tombstone search) at 0.999 recall@10 touching 1.4% of vectors, IVF-PQ ADC + rerank (24x compression), RaBitQ-style 1-bit codes, BM25+RRF hybrid & bit-exact native C++20 kernels
- [`slopguard`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/slopguard): Heuristic checker for AI-generated code — Python AST + regex TS/JSX rules for stubs, unresolved imports, empty tests; C++20 prescreen, Claude Code hook, MCP
- [`tokendiet`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tokendiet): Context compressor for AI coding agents — knapsack log pruning (C++20 kernel, Python fallback), AST skeletons, cross-turn read dedup. CLI + MCP server
- [`syntara`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara): Grammar-Constrained Structured Decoding Engine: JSON Schema/Regex -> Minimal Byte DFA (Thompson/Rabin-Scott/Moore), Native C++20 Prefix-Sharing Token Index (112-142x, bit-exact), Byte-Level Earley CFG Constraints & Exact Closed-Set Choice Scoring
- [`tracegit`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit): Content-addressed version control for AI agent execution traces — SQLite/SHA-256 Merkle DAG, C++20 edit-distance diff/bisect, loop detector, CI gate & MCP
- [`nexus-verity`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/nexus-verity): Causal discovery & off-policy evaluation toolkit — PC graph discovery, d-separation, cross-fitted Double ML, split conformal, and C++ doubly-robust OPE
- [`aether-compiler`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aether-compiler): Tensor-graph compiler — SSA IR with CSE/operator-fusion/DCE optimization passes, C++20 static memory arena planner, and analytic GPU tile cost model
- [`helios-consensus`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/helios-consensus): Library-style Raft in Python with segmented binary WAL, asyncio TCP, Multi-Raft sharding, Jepsen-style fault injection, WGL linearizability & C++20 kernels
- [`privora-graph`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/privora-graph): Privacy & robustness toolkit — DP-SGD with RDP accounting, bi-temporal PageRank retrieval, Multi-Krum/geometric-median aggregation. Reference implementation
- [`aegis-runtime`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime): Deterministic policy & audit runtime for AI-agent tool execution — capability policy DSL, transactional saga compensation, and Ed25519 Merkle audit ledger
- [`prism-gate`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate): OpenAI-compatible LLM routing gateway — TCP-Vegas adaptive concurrency control, latency/cost cascade routing, and PSI/JSD distribution drift detection
- [`company-os`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os): CompanyOS — run ANY company with a team of AI agents. Config-driven (company.json), 7 role-agents, SIM + LIVE modes, kanban dashboard, KPI engine.
- [`surya-shiksha`](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/surya-shiksha): Surya Shiksha — Multi-Agent Adaptive Learning Operating System (12 Specialized AI Agents, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL & Prisma).

## Authored Technical Handbooks & Corporate Training Monographs (PDF)
- [SAP S/4HANA, Clean-Core OData MCP & Governed Enterprise AI](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks/Nagarjuna_Kamireddy_SAP_Enterprise_AI_Handbook.pdf): Order-to-Cash & 3-way PO-GR-IR agentic workflows, server-side BUKRS RBAC, IBAN/Tax-ID masking, and Clean-Core OData v4 MCP patterns.
- [Securing AI Agents, Prompt-Injection Defence & HITL Guardrails](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks/Nagarjuna_Kamireddy_Securing_AI_Agents_Guardrails_Handbook.pdf): Three-layer deterministic input/tool/output containment, OWASP ASI01–ASI05 mitigations, SKILL.md/MCP static taint scanning, and HITL approvals.
- [Agent Evaluation, Golden Datasets, Retries & Circuit Breakers](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks/Nagarjuna_Kamireddy_Agent_Evaluation_Reliability_Handbook.pdf): Outcome vs trajectory evaluation, 255-check CI quality gates, deterministic vs judge scoring, idempotent retries, and circuit breakers.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP), Context Engineering & Multi-Agent Systems](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks/Nagarjuna_Kamireddy_MCP_Context_Engineering_Handbook.pdf): Host-Client-Server MCP contracts, prefix-cached context engineering, hybrid BM25 + dense + Neo4j GraphRAG citations, and subagent isolation.
- [Enterprise AI Gateways, Multi-Model Routing, vLLM & LangGraph](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks/Nagarjuna_Kamireddy_AI_Gateways_LangGraph_Handbook.pdf): Multi-provider complexity cascades, virtual-key FinOps caps, self-hosted vLLM PagedAttention economics, and durable LangGraph checkpoints.
- [Generative & Agentic AI for Engineering Documentation (Oil, Gas & Heavy Industry)](https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks/Nagarjuna_Kamireddy_GenAI_Oil_Gas_Engineering_Docs_Deck.pdf): Citation-grounded hybrid search over P&IDs, OEM datasheets, MOCs & SAP PM work orders with multi-step vision agents (~30% to ~70% accuracy).
- [SkillBench v1.0.0 — Static Information-Flow Taint Analyzer & C++20 Aho-Corasick Injection Prover for SKILL.md & MCP Servers](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/skillbench): 29.07x C++20 speedup (14.454 ms on 5,000 docs), 30/30 behavioral suite accuracy, 0.0% false positives, 98.20% branch coverage.
